name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
February 11, 2014
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Vera Bayliss, President, Brother Benno’s Auxiliary
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation Declaring February to be "World Spay Month" and February 25, 2014, "Spay Day USA" in the City of Vista.
P2.
Proclamation Declaring February to be "American Heart Health Month" in the City of Vista.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending December 31, 2013 (CC)
C4.
Vista Village Business Association Special Event Banner for the St. Patrick's Day Parade/Festival (CC)
C5.
Fiscal Year 2013/14 Urban Area Security Initiative Grant Award (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , accepting grant funds of $231,030 and amending the FY 2013/14 Operating Budget;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , approving the MOU/Grant Assurances; and
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , approving the Third Amendment to the agreement with Lynx Technologies for San Diego Regional Public Safety GIS Services.
C6.
Housing-Related Parks Grant Application (CC)
C7.
Ambulance Purchases (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , approving the purchase of two ambulances from Emergency Vehicle Group, Inc.; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , amending the FY 2013/14 Operating Budget.
DISCUSSION
D1.
Fiscal Year 2013/14 Second Quarter Financial Report (CC)
1.
Receive the report;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , amending the FY 2013/14 Operating Budget;
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , amending the FY 2013/14 Capital Improvement Program (CIP) Budget; and
4.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , amending the City-Wide Classification and Compensation Index.
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Temporary Use Permits Code Amendment (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive testimony regarding the proposed amendment to the Vista Development Code regulations; and
2.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2014- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 18.76 of the Vista Development Code with Respect to Temporary Use Permits for Auto, Recreational Vehicle and Boat Sales."
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
